title: Fawwaz Tower
description: A cinematic dark fantasy experience inspired by Pick Me Up: Infinite Gacha.
body:
Built on Logic. Rising in Victory.

A cinematic, production-quality single-page portfolio inspired by the Pick Me Up (Infinite Gacha) manhwa system, fused with Stoic philosophy. Every floor earned. Every skill forged.

star.situation: I set out to build FAWWAZ TOWER as a cinematic, system-driven portfolio inspired by tower ascension mechanics and stoic philosophy — where every section represents a floor, and every interaction reinforces progression and discipline.
star.task: Design and implement a single-page application that delivers an immersive 'Tower Ascension' experience, integrating system UI elements, performance-conscious design, and a coherent philosophical identity.
star.action: I structured the application into layered 'floors' to reflect progression, implemented system-driven components such as Tower Mode, Hall of Echoes, and a cinematic audio player, and enforced a zero-image design using CSS-driven visuals. Each element was built to serve both performance and narrative, ensuring the interface remained responsive, consistent, and purposeful.
star.result: The project stands as a cohesive system rather than a collection of features. Navigation reflects progression, interaction reinforces immersion, and performance remains stable through constraint-driven design. The tower communicates its philosophy clearly — not through excess, but through structure and discipline.

technicalFailures.title: Color Misalignment
technicalFailures.what: I chose colors based on what looked impressive in isolation, resulting in a visually inconsistent interface that weakened the dark fantasy and stoic identity of the tower.
technicalFailures.why: I treated color as decoration rather than as a system. There was no constraint, no hierarchy, and no alignment with the core theme.
technicalFailures.lesson: Color is not chosen — it is assigned. It must serve structure, mood, and clarity, or it becomes noise.

technicalFailures.title: Misunderstanding Supabase Oauth
technicalFailures.what: I misunderstood how Supabase Oauth works, leading to unexpected behavior and errors coming from the OAuth flow.
technicalFailures.why: I did not fully understand the OAuth flow and how it interacts with Supabase.
technicalFailures.lesson: taking care to unserstanding core concepts of OAuth spend less time debugging and more time building reliable authentication flows.
